title: Vibra diagnostic
description: One structured diagnostic, DiagnosticDocument version 2, as rendered to JSON by the command line. Spans are half-open UTF-8 byte ranges; line and column are derived display data.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of this contract. A reader rejects a version it cannot interpret.

level.description: The level registered for the code. A project cannot change it.

message.description: Text for a person. Tests do not assert its wording.

related.description: Additional spans that explain the diagnostic.

fixes.description: Fixes the diagnostic describes. Empty when the code's fix capability is @none. A diagnostic never applies a fix.

diagnosticCode.description: A stable atom of the form @domain.condition, both components camelCase.

position.description: A one-based display position. The column counts Unicode scalar values.

span.description: SpanDocument: a half-open UTF-8 byte range with start not after end, and its endpoints as derived display positions. A failure with no location has a null sourceId, offsets 0 and 0, and positions 1:1.

sourceId.description: The source identity owning the span, or null.

fix.description: A fix descriptor. The edit is a separate plan that checks revisions.
